instruction: Run a speed test on speedtest.net and save the results as JSON to ~/Test/Speed/test_data.json, creating the directory if needed.

metadata.explanation: Task requires running speedtest.net and exporting results as JSON with standard fields (ping, download, upload). The evaluator checks if the JSON file contains all required fields. Custom getter parses JSON file and returns data dict, custom metric verifies required fields are present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads JSON file from the specified path and parses it into a dictionary
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('required_fields') without incorrectly trying expected.get('rules')
Evaluator verifies all key requirements: file location (/home/user/Test/Speed/test_data.json), valid JSON format, and presence of standard speedtest fields (ping, download, upload)
Partial credit logic is appropriate - returns found_count/total_count, allowing scoring when some but not all fields are present
Error handling covers edge cases: missing file, invalid JSON, empty data, missing fields
Semantic match is correct: instruction requires exporting speedtest results with standard fields, and evaluator checks exactly those fields
